I've made a breakthrough! I realized `leftmost(ofcolor(I, x6))` can be 0 when the frontier is horizontal. This leads to a `dmirror` operation, transforming horizontal frontiers into vertical columns. The implications are significant for how the algorithm processes and potentially simplifies the grid. I'm verifying this now with the example data.

I've just had a breakthrough in how frontiers and mirrors interact.
